accepted.question_text: Let σ: G → Aut(M) be an ergodic action of a compact group G on a Neumann algebra M. Must M necessarily be finite?
accepted.context_brief: Ergodic compact-group actions on Neumann algebras

accepted.question_text: Let S: X → Y and T: Y → Z be closed operators, and let A: X → Y and B: Y → Z be bounded operators. Define S̃ = S + A and T̃ = T + B. It is known, when X, Y, and Z are Hilbert spaces, that dim N(T̃)/R(S̃) = dim N(T)/R(S) < ∞. Does the same estimate remain valid when X, Y, and Z are Banach spaces instead of Hilbert spaces?
accepted.context_brief: Stability of a dimension estimate under bounded perturbations

evidence.quote: Given closed operators S: X → Y, T: Y → Z and bounded operators A: X → Y, B: Y → Z. Let S̃ = S + A, T̃ = T + B. Known that dim N(T̃) / R(S̃)=dim N(T) / R(S)<∞ if X, Y, Z are Hilbert spaces. Does the same estimate hold if X, Y, Z are Banach spaces?
